body.message:
Please note that the apartment is available from September, with a rate of AED 4,000 for 30 nights.

Kindly note that a refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be arranged on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you with the booking arrangements.
